description: React component implementing the client-side UI for document ingestion and persona generation workflow in a Next.js frontend. Includes file upload management, progress indication, and orchestrating API calls for build creation, document upload, and orchestration execution.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string with appropriate units (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase or 'FILE' if extension is absent or filename is uppercase.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID composed of alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Maps an upload category to a human-readable label.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Provides a descriptive title for each upload category, used in UI labels.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns a color code associated with an upload category for styling purposes.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the string of accepted file MIME types/extensions for file input.
